extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents registered before the USPTO, Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff, and disciplinary counsel
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive requirements for imposing reciprocal discipline under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24 (exclusion from practice before the USPTO) including notice, opportunity to respond, publication, and post-exclusion duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounds for exclusion under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24 / violation of § 11.804(h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent is excluded from the practice of patent, trademark, and other non-patent law before the USPTO for violation of 37 C.F.R. § 11.804(h).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exclusion here was imposed as reciprocal discipline identical to the discipline imposed by the State of Michigan Attorney Disciplinary Board (disbarment). The Notice states the exclusion is for "violating 37 C.F.R. § 11.804(h) by being disbarred from the practice of law by a duly constituted authority of a State."

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and opportunity to respond (40-day response period)
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director sent a 'Notice and Order Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.24' notifying Respondent and providing an opportunity to file a response opposing reciprocal discipline within forty (40) days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice and Order was sent by certified mail (receipt number provided) and was delivered to Respondent on August 7, 2023. The Notice informed Respondent he could oppose imposition of reciprocal discipline based on one or more of the reasons provided in 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of failure to respond — no genuine issue of material fact
rubrics_metrics.description: If Respondent fails to file a response, the Office may determine there is no genuine issue of material fact under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d) and impose reciprocal discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In this matter, Respondent did not file a response to the Notice and Order; the Office therefore determined there was no genuine issue of material fact and that exclusion from practice was the appropriate discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal authority for action
rubrics_metrics.description: Disciplinary action taken pursuant to statutory and regulatory authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This action is taken pursuant to the provisions of 35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. § 11.24.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic publication of Final Order
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall electronically publish the Final Order at OED's electronic FOIA Reading Room.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order must be published where disciplinary decisions are available for public review: https://foiadocuments.uspto.gov/oed/ (the order also mentions http://foiadocuments.uspto.gov).

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Gazette notice — content and consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall publish a Notice in the Official Gazette that is materially consistent with the provided 'Notice of Exclusion' template.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice of Exclusion template includes: the respondent's name and registration number; statement of exclusion from practice before the USPTO for violating § 11.804(h) by being disbarred; citation to the state disciplinary order (case numbers and date); summary of the underlying misconduct (here, convictions and statutory citations); and citation to 35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. § 11.24 as authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to disciplinary enforcement agencies, courts, and the public (37 C.F.R. § 11.59)
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director must give notice of the public discipline and the reasons for it to disciplinary enforcement agencies in the states where the respondent is admitted, to courts where the respondent is known to be admitted, and to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice requirement is to be carried out pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.59 and must include the reasons for the discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent duties after exclusion — compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall comply with the duties enumerated in 37 C.F.R. § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the order does not recite § 11.58's text, the directive requires the excluded practitioner to follow the post-discipline duties set forth in that regulation (e.g., client notification, transition of files, trust account handling, as applicable under § 11.58).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissociation of USPTO accounts and Customer Numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO shall dissociate the respondent's name from any Customer Number(s) and USPTO verified Electronic System account(s), if any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an administrative step to prevent the excluded individual from being associated with or using USPTO electronic systems and accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service of the Final Order — certificate of service and mailing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Final Order must be mailed by first-class certified mail, return receipt requested, to the Respondent at the most recent address provided to the OED Director pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.11(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The certificate of service included in this order certifies mailing to the respondent at a correctional facility address and notes the USPTO mailing address for the OED. The Notice previously recorded the certified mail receipt number used to effect service.
